colour_review.reason: Native facing edges show olive hatching and orange printed fill inside their frames, with much closer paper colours outside. Matching the fills would alter printed map information. Cross-fading displaced road linework risks ghosting. No reliable paper-only correction was identified that would remove this dominant contrast.
